import json, hashlib, resource, time
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'code'))
import classification_plane_cohiggs_kernel_pointwise as c
q=c.q
ROOT=Path.cwd()
JOB='research/classification/jobs/plane_cohiggs_fullrank_tau_zero_two_normal.json'
OUTPUT='reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_COHIGGS_FULLRANK_TAU_ZERO_TWO_NORMAL_20261108.json'
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(175,180))
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3*1024**3,3*1024**3))
started=time.monotonic()
job=json.loads((ROOT/JOB).read_text())
for x in job['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
packet=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_RANK_ZERO_FULLRANK_WEIGHTS_20261107.json').read_text())
first,second=c.bases()
def mm(A,B): return q.matmul(A,B)
def addP(*Ps):
    return q.antisymmetric({ij:q.add(*(P.get(ij,{}) for P in Ps)) for ij in c.PAIRS})
def scaleP(P,p):
    return q.antisymmetric({ij:q.mul(p,P.get(ij,{})) for ij in c.PAIRS})
def d2solve(D2,C,rhs):
    R,COL=C['minor_rows'],C['minor_columns']
    inv=q.inverse([[D2[i][j] for j in COL] for i in R])
    sol=[sum(row[k]*(-rhs[R[k]]) for k in range(9)) for row in inv]
    out=[F(0)]*9
    for j,v in zip(COL,sol):out[j]=v
    return out
def zero_parameter(poly,index):
    return {e:v for e,v in poly.items() if e[5+index]==0}
def factor(poly):
    if not poly:return {'Pf_zero':True}
    e=[min(x[i] for x in poly) for i in range(5)]+[0,0,0]
    if any(e):
        quotient={tuple(a-b for a,b in zip(x,e)):v for x,v in poly.items()}
        assert q.mul({tuple(e):F(1)},quotient)==poly
        return {'factor_exponents':e,'quotient':c.polynomial_records(quotient)}
    return None
def universal_shear(P0,curve,S):
    n=13;x=[c.atom_n(index=i,n=n) for i in range(n)]
    G=list(x);H=list(x)
    for i in range(3):
        delta=q.add(q.mul(x[7+i],x[3]),q.mul(x[10+i],x[4]))
        G[i]=q.add(x[i],delta);H[i]=q.add(x[i],q.scale(delta,-1))
    assert [c.subst(v,H) for v in G]==x
    assert [c.subst(v,G) for v in H]==x
    P={ij:c.lift(p,n) for ij,p in P0.items()}
    push=c.push(P,G,H)
    residual={}
    for ij in c.PAIRS:
        weight1={e:v for e,v in q.add(push.get(ij,{}),q.scale(P.get(ij,{}),-1)).items()
                 if e[3]+e[4]-sum(i>=3 for i in ij)==1}
        expected=q.add(*(q.mul(x[7+j],c.lift(c.tensor_linear(first,[S[i][j] for i in range(30)]).get(ij,{}),n)) for j in range(6)))
        residual[ij]=q.add(weight1,q.scale(expected,-1))
    for i,j,k in combinations(range(5),3):
        assert not q.add(q.mul(x[i],residual[j,k]),q.scale(q.mul(x[j],residual[i,k]),-1),q.mul(x[k],residual[i,j]))
    C={ij:c.lift(p,n) for ij,p in curve.items()}
    back=c.push(c.push(C,G,H),H,G)
    assert all(C.get(ij,{})==back.get(ij,{}) for ij in c.PAIRS)
    return {'six_independent_shear_parameters':True,'polynomial_inverse_G_minus_C':True,
            'determinant':'1','saved_full_S_mod_Euler_verified':True,
            'full150_whole_uv_roundtrip':True}
results=[]
for record in packet['cases']:
    wall=next(v for v in record['all_exceptional_roots'] if v['tau']=='0')
    K=c.mat(wall['D1']['complete_kernel'],F(0))
    S=c.mat(record['complete_actual_shear_30_by6'],F(0))
    D2=c.mat(record['complete_D2_350_by9'],F(0))
    assert wall['D1']['nullity']==8 and wall['D2']['nullity']==0
    CS=wall['actual_shear'];assert CS['rank']==6 and CS['minor_columns']==list(range(6))
    I=CS['minor_rows'];A=mm(q.inverse([S[i] for i in I]),[K[i] for i in I])
    R=[[K[i][j]-sum(S[i][k]*A[k][j] for k in range(6)) for j in range(8)] for i in range(30)]
    normals=[];B=[];pivots=[]
    remaining=[row[:] for row in R]
    for _ in range(2):
        j=next(j for j in range(8) if any(row[j] for row in remaining))
        p=next(i for i in range(30) if remaining[i][j])
        N=[row[j]/remaining[p][j] for row in remaining]
        coeff=remaining[p][:]
        normals.append(N);B.append(coeff);pivots.append(p)
        remaining=[[remaining[i][j]-N[i]*coeff[j] for j in range(8)] for i in range(30)]
    assert not any(v for row in remaining for v in row)
    assert all(not N[i] for N in normals for i in I)
    P0=c.constant_tensor(record['normal_form_P0'],F(0))
    N=[c.tensor_linear(first,v) for v in normals]
    rhs=[q.jvec(q.jacobi(N[0])),q.jvec(q.jacobi(addP(N[0],N[1]))),q.jvec(q.jacobi(N[1]))]
    rhs[1]=[b-a-d for a,b,d in zip(rhs[0],rhs[1],rhs[2])]
    QC=[d2solve(D2,wall['D2'],v) for v in rhs]
    Q=[c.tensor_linear(second,v) for v in QC]
    u,v=q.atom(1,5),q.atom(1,6)
    curve=addP(P0,scaleP(N[0],u),scaleP(N[1],v),
               scaleP(Q[0],q.mul(u,u)),scaleP(Q[1],q.mul(u,v)),scaleP(Q[2],q.mul(v,v)))
    J=q.jacobi(curve)
    powers=[(i,j) for i in range(5) for j in range(5-i)]
    rowpolys=[]
    for n in range(350):
        d={f'{i},{j}':str(q.jvec(J,(i,j,0))[n]) for i,j in powers if q.jvec(J,(i,j,0))[n]}
        rowpolys.append(d)
    assert all(not e[7] and sum(e[5:7])<=4 for p in J.values() for e in p)
    assert not any(q.jvec(J,(0,0,0))) and not any(q.jvec(J,(1,0,0))) and not any(q.jvec(J,(0,1,0)))
    Factual=c.divisor(curve)
    forcing=[];remaining_rows=[dict(r) for r in rowpolys];forced=set()
    for _ in range(2):
        found=None
        for i,row in enumerate(remaining_rows):
            if len(row)!=1:continue
            mon,coef=next(iter(row.items()));ex=tuple(map(int,mon.split(',')))
            active=[j for j in range(2) if ex[j]]
            if len(active)==1 and active[0] not in forced:
                found=(i,active[0],ex,coef);break
        if found is None:break
        i,j,ex,coef=found;forced.add(j)
        forcing.append({'original350row':i,'coefficient':coef,'u_v_exponents':list(ex),'deduced_zero_parameter':j})
        remaining_rows=[{m:a for m,a in row.items() if tuple(map(int,m.split(',')))[j]==0} for row in remaining_rows]
    restricted=Factual
    for j in forced:restricted=zero_parameter(restricted,j)
    direct=factor(restricted)
    if len(forced)==2:
        assert not restricted
        conclusion='both_normals_forced_zero_actual_Pf_zero__EMPTY'
    elif direct:
        conclusion='whole_original_support_coordinate_factor_or_Pfzero__EMPTY'
    else:
        conclusion='explicit_complete_two_normal_model__E_UNRESOLVED'
    results.append({'source':record['type'],'tau':'0','all_8_kernel_6_shear_9_P2_retained':True,
                    'saved_shear_minor_rows':I,'old_D2_inverse_rows':wall['D2']['minor_rows'],
                    'old_D2_inverse_columns':wall['D2']['minor_columns'],
                    'K_equals_SA_plus_NB_all30by8':True,
                    'A_6by8':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in A],
                    'B_2by8':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in B],
                    'normal_coordinates_30by2':[[str(N[i]) for N in normals] for i in range(30)],
                    'P0':c.tensor_records(P0),'N1':c.tensor_records(N[0]),'N2':c.tensor_records(N[1]),
                    'Q20_Q11_Q02_coordinates':[[str(v) for v in row] for row in QC],
                    'curve':c.tensor_records(curve),'full350_original_rows_as_uv_polynomials':rowpolys,
                    'actual_Pf_all126_uv_polynomials':c.polynomial_records(Factual),
                    'original_single_monomial_row_forcing':forcing,
                    'restricted_actual_factor_certificate':direct,
                    'actual_global_shear_inverse':universal_shear(P0,curve,S),
                    'whole_source_conclusion':conclusion})
out=ROOT/OUTPUT;assert not out.exists()
result={'task_id':'E_reduced_nonnormal','status':'ONE_whole_two_source_finite_batch_completed',
        'all_explicit_identities_passed':True,'cases':results,
        'both_whole_sources_empty_proved':all('EMPTY' in x['whole_source_conclusion'] for x in results),
        'no_new_M1_rank_minor_point_GB_or_jet':True,
        'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
        'exact_inputs':job['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],
        'inline_caller_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(job['inline_caller_source'].encode()).hexdigest(),
        'inline_caller_source':job['inline_caller_source'],
        'old_code_reports_main_frontier_globals_unchanged':True}
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
for x in results:print(x['source'],x['whole_source_conclusion'],x['original_single_monomial_row_forcing'],flush=True)
print('PASS explicit whole model',result['seconds'],result['maximum_RSS_KiB'],flush=True)
